info.name: w2w-api
info.description: Postman collection for the current Work2Work API feature set.

variable.description: JWT token — populate by running the Login request first, then copy the token value here.

request.description: Public endpoint — no token required. On success, copy the returned `token` value into the `bearerToken` collection variable.
Returns full employee detail view including assigned positions, autofill options, and comments.
Partial update. Only provided fields will be modified.

Returns employees with grouped day buckets relative to the requested startDate. Each bucket date is formatted like Friday Apr-11, shift times are formatted like 6am or 6:43am, category values use the category short description, employmentType is currently returned as null, each employee includes alertDate and publishedStage fields, and optional positionIds/categoryIds filters limit both the returned employees and their shift buckets.

Returns a wrapped response with title, totalShifts, totalHours, and dates[]. Each date bucket now splits into weekday and ISO date fields, date-position category values use the category short description, each shift time uses 6am or 6:43am formatting, each shift includes employmentType as null, and optional positionIds/categoryIds filters limit both the totals and the per-day buckets.
Returns the normalized grouped response. Results are always grouped by date first under dates[], then by position and shift timing under nested shiftGroups[].
Returns the normalized grouped response. Results are always grouped by date first under dates[], then directly by shift timing under shiftGroups[].
Returns the normalized grouped response. Results are always grouped by date first under dates[], then by category and shift timing under nested shiftGroups[].

item.name: Calendar View - Category Short Name Shift Timings

request.description: Returns the normalized grouped response. Results are always grouped by date first under dates[], then by category short description and shift timing under nested shiftGroups[].

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Selector (Day Position)

request.description: Returns the same day-position bucket payload as /api/scheduling/shifts/day-position, selected through the grouped endpoint via grouping=position.

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Day Position And Timing

request.description: Returns day buckets for the requested range, with each day grouped by position and then by shift timing. Each timing bucket lists employee-level shift entries. All company positions are included even when a given day has no shifts for them. Each day, position bucket, and timing bucket includes shiftCount and totalDuration.

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Selector (Day Position Shift Timings)

request.description: Returns day-position-shift-timing buckets through the grouped endpoint via grouping=position_shift_timings.

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Selector (Day Shift Timings)

request.description: Returns day-shift-timing buckets through the grouped endpoint via grouping=shift_timings. This payload does not include aggregate shift counts or durations.

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Selector (Day Category Shift Timings)

request.description: Returns day-category-shift-timing buckets through the grouped endpoint via grouping=category_shift_timings. This payload does not include aggregate shift counts or durations.

item.name: Get Grouped Shifts By Selector (Cat Shift Timings)

request.description: Returns the same day-category-shift-timing payload shape as grouping=category_shift_timings, but category buckets use the category short description via grouping=cat_shift_timings.
Creates a pending full-day time off request using the form inputs from the New Time Off Request screen. Managers can create for any employee by setting employeeId.

body.raw:
{
  "employeeId": {{employeeId}},
  "startDate": "2026-04-22",
  "endDate": "2026-04-23",
  "fullDay": true,
  "comments": "Manager applied time off for employee"
}

request.description: Creates a pending time off request on behalf of an employee. Use this for manager-driven time off application.

item.name: Create Partial Or Repeating Time Off Request

request.description: Creates a pending partial or repeating time off request using start/end times and a repeat count. Managers can create for any employee by setting employeeId.
Returns tenant-scoped time off requests with the display fields used by the time-off list, including end date/time text, requested timestamp, comments, and repeat summary.
Approves or declines a pending time off request. Managers can use this to process employee time off requests. Use action: APPROVE or action: DECLINE.
Cancels a pending time off request. Employees can cancel their own requests, and managers can cancel any request in their tenant.
Triggered when an employee submits a new leave request.
Triggered when a leave request is approved.
Triggered when a leave request is rejected.
Publish schedule using scheduleId. Roles and dates are fetched from the database.
Unpublish schedule for all employees.
